experiment.name: FUSE001 NIST SARD CWE-259 C catalogue regression
experiment.scope_limit: Rule-specific regression only. SARD Juliet cases are synthetic mixed-path inputs. This result is not a precision, recall, field-accuracy, or firmware-coverage estimate.

selection.note: Complete result set from one paginated API query. The listed cases contain mixed good and bad paths and are a rule-specific regression cohort, not a representative firmware accuracy sample.

summary.accuracy_metric_limit: The catalogue's SARIF source targets label weakness flows, while each mixed case also contains good paths. A matching macro name and source literal token only establish exact text duplication, not credential validity or flow. File-level matches outside the SARIF target cannot be classified as false positives from these labels alone.
